properties.name: editable
properties.description: Enable cell editing. Either a boolean (all rows) or a predicate per row.

properties.name: mode
properties.description: Table mode: simple uses ITableColumn; advanced uses TanStack ColumnDef passthrough.

properties.name: columns
properties.description: An array of column definitions. Required in simple mode.

properties.name: columnDefs
properties.description: TanStack column definitions. Required in advanced mode.

properties.name: tableOptions
properties.description: Passthrough TanStack table options (getSubRows, getExpandedRowModel, etc.).

properties.name: customClass
properties.description: Custom CSS class to apply to the inner div.

properties.name: density
properties.description: The density of the table, used to save space or increase readability.

properties.name: hover
properties.description: Enable hover effect on table rows.

properties.name: currentPage
properties.description: The current page number in pagination (1-based index).

properties.name: pageSizeOptions
properties.description: Available options for the number of rows per page.

properties.name: showPageSizeSelector
properties.description: Show/hide the page size selector in pagination.

properties.name: sortable
properties.description: Enable sorting functionality for sortable columns.

properties.name: selectable
properties.description: Row selection mode: 'none' for no selection, 'single' for single row, 'multi' for multiple rows.

properties.name: isRowSelectable
properties.description: Per-row predicate function controlling row selection eligibility.

properties.name: selectedRowIds
properties.description: Array of selected row IDs. Used for controlled selection state.

properties.name: zebra
properties.description: Zebra striped tables differentiate rows by styling them in an alternating fashion.

properties.name: caption
properties.description: Accessibility caption for the table (visually hidden but available to screen readers).

events.name: cellEditCommit
events.detail: { rowIndex: number; colId: string; newValue: unknown; updatedRow: Record<string, unknown
events.description: Emits when cell editing is committed with the new value.

events.name: rowClick
events.description: Emits when a row is clicked.

events.name: sortChange
events.description: Emits when sorting changes with the new sorting state.

events.name: paginationChange
events.description: Emits when pagination changes with the new pagination state.

events.name: rowSelectionChange
events.description: Emits when row selection changes with the selected rows and their IDs.

methods.name: getTableInstance
methods.description: Returns the underlying TanStack table instance (advanced mode).
